name: glpi-plugin-manageentities
description: Version pinning of the third-party bundles vendored under public/lib/, so that npm audit and Dependabot can see them. The plugin has no JavaScript build step: installing this manifest produces no artefact the plugin uses. Nothing is pinned at the moment -- the only library still vendored is jQuery Gantt, which is absent from npm; see public/lib/VERSIONS.md.
